one_constructed_weight_pattern: From the exact A8.2 no-update checkpoint, set all selected relay-to-motor edges whose source preferred time-to-contact is 500000, 400000, 300000 or 200000 microseconds to the existing 0-mV lower bound. Keep all 150000/100000/75000/50000/25000/0-microsecond selected edges and every unselected edge unchanged.
probe: The identical frozen 32-note A5 panel with unchanged motor readout, game, neuron and queue state, cue gains, RNG state, topology, and no exploration or plasticity.
comparator: A8.2 no_update checkpoint and saved frozen probe
primary_endpoint: Number of probe notes with GOOD+ on their first DOWN and no earlier same-note null DOWN; report first-DOWN signed offsets and silent-note count.

interpretation_locked_before_probe.narrow_existence_witness: At least one note has first-DOWN GOOD+ without an earlier same-note null DOWN. This proves only that the fixed architecture can express that behavior in at least one frozen context.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.witness_failed: No note meets the first-DOWN GOOD+ criterion; report whether it is early, late or silent. This does not prove all weight vectors fail.
interpretation_locked_before_probe.inconclusive: State, mask, comparator or probe replay cannot be verified.

prohibitions: no claim of a learned or biological policy
stop: Save one branch, raw actions and motor trace, independent audit and report; stop before another mechanism or training stage.
